MATH 235: Linear Algebra 2 for Honours Mathematics
Description: Orthogonal and unitary matrices and transformations. Orthogonal projections, Gram-Schmidt procedure, best approximations, least-squares. Inner products, angles and orthogonality, orthogonal diagonalization, singular value decomposition, applications.
Requirements: Prereq: (MATH 106 or 114 or 115 with a grade of at least 70%) or (MATH 136 with a grade of at least 60%) or MATH 146; Honours Mathematics or Mathematical Physics students. Coreq: MATH 128 or 138 or 148. Antireq: MATH 225, 245
